# The build backend, pinned exactly and hash-locked, for `uv build` in
# publish.yml (`--build-constraints` with `--require-hashes`). The release
# build resolves nothing else from an index, so these hashes are the whole of
# the third-party code that runs where the uploaded files are written.
#
# Authored in the private development upstream under publish/overlays/ and laid
# into this tree by the release export; edit it there, not here. Keep the
# hatchling pin equal to `requires` in pyproject.toml (a test checks it).
# Regenerate after a deliberate bump with:
#   echo "hatchling==<version>" | uv pip compile - --generate-hashes \
#     --universal --python-version 3.11 --no-header -o <this file>
